decisions.reason: Section 1 explains the session/tool worker runs inside the host process whose package tree npm removes (cites log 16:41:02 cleaning / 16:41:05 remove before fetch), so the host dies mid-install and the tool result is never durably recorded; grounded in fixture log and env-state.

Section 2 identifies content-present-but-shims-missing (dsh/dsh.cmd missing, dsh.ps1 stale from env-state.txt), explains shims vs package directory, and argues hand-swapping/hand-writing shims is wrong repair.

Section 3 grounds the fix in repair-notes.md: external re-run of pinned `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1` regenerates shims, verify with dsh --version -> 0.1.2-rc.1; explicitly rejects hand-patching and notes unpinned floating installs as wrong.

Section 4: agent must never execute the global host install from inside, refuse and hand off an external procedure, with step 1 fully stopping every dsh process before npm runs and pinned version in the hand-off command; best-effort in-place explicitly excluded.

Section 5 proposes a self-host-mutation intent guard before tool execution (resolve target against running process module origin) plus a checklist covering dsh --version/shim verification, plugin load verification after upgrade, and dsh-old-* backup cleanup; notes zero-diff version-bump hop as valid no-remigration outcome.
